10.1002_adsc.70442: Herein, the first use of CHCl 3 as a “traceless” reagent to trigger a 1,2‐aryl migration for the synthesis of vinyl ketones has been developed. Its success relies on a continuous‐flow strategy that harnesses the synergistic cathodic reduction of CHCl 3 and anodic oxidation of Cl − and carbon‐centered radicals. This electrochemical method operates under catalyst‐free conditions and employs low‐concentration electrolytes along with low‐cost electrodes, thereby enhancing its practicality and sustainability.
10.1039_d6ta05844b: Oxygen-vacancy engineering regulates the electronic structure and Zn 2+ /H + storage kinetics of Mn 2 O 3 , promoting ion transport, reversible dual-ion storage, and improved rate capability and cycling stability in aqueous zinc-ion batteries.
